note: Static declarations for the upstream VT suites. A suite's eligible set may only be reduced by a STATIC capability precondition declared here (kernel/01 K-01 S_cap); runtime or manual skips and difference entries are forbidden for a 100% suite (X=0). Every exclusion must cite an ADR and a kernel/01 clause.

suites.name: esctest2
suites.claimed_vt_level_rule: ADR-0030 D-1: claimed_vt_level is the highest N whose xterm DA1 expected set is entirely implemented. Level 1 = [1,2] (VT100 + Advanced Video Option), which this implementation can claim; level 2 would require 6/9/15/22/29 and is not claimable.

static_capability_exclusions.reason: OSC 4 / 10 / 11 / 12 are not implemented in v1 and are never answered. There is no colour rendering yet, so answering with a palette would be an unprovable capability claim (AR-20). Declaring the capability absent is the static precondition; it is not a difference entry and it expires when colour rendering lands.
static_capability_exclusions.excluded_case_count_source: docs/audit/esctest-failing-index.md: the five prefixes above account for 13+13+14+2+5 = 47 located failing cases

static_capability_exclusions.citation: ADR-0032 D1; AR-14 (pixels stay out of the VT layer); E-P0-2 not implemented; kernel/01 K-01 S_cap
static_capability_exclusions.reason: Window manipulation (iconify/deiconify, move, push/pop icon and window titles, report icon/window label, DECSLPP, pixel resize) is a property of a window host that v1 does not have. The VT layer answers 11t/13t truthfully as normal and 0;0, so pretending a window was moved would be a lie (AR-20). Static precondition, not a runtime skip and not a difference entry. Revoke when E-P0-2 lands.
static_capability_exclusions.excluded_case_count_source: docs/audit/esctest-level1-triage.md: the XtermWinopsTests failures that fail in isolation

static_capability_exclusions.citation: ADR-0032 D2/D3; kernel/03 (cols change only on resize, reflow writeback is rejected by V-06); kernel/01 K-03
static_capability_exclusions.reason: DECCOLM (CSI ? 3 h, 80/132 columns) is not implemented in v1: the grid's column count is fixed and reflow writeback is frozen out by kernel/03 V-06. DA1 bit 1 keeps its DEC/ECMA meaning (VT100 + AVO) under the K-03 arbitration order, so it is not a promise of 132-column support. Static precondition; revoke with E-P0-2.
